description_en: Queries the list of components for a production studio
description_zh: 调用DescribeCasterComponents查询导播台组件列表
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-caster-components --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id LIVEPRODUCER_POST-cn-0pp1czt0000 --component-id 21926b36-7dd2-4fde-ae25-51b5bc8e0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCasterComponents

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.

If you created the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, obtain the ID from the CasterId parameter in the response.

If you created the production studio in the LIVE console, go to the Cloud Production Studio page by choosing LIVE Console > Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio.

The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。
如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en: The component ID. If you added the component by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848030.html operation, obtain the ID from the ComponentId parameter in the response
parameters.help_zh: 组件ID。如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848030.html添加导播台组件，请查看AddCasterComponent接口调用返回的参数ComponentId值
parameters.name: component_id

CaptionLayerContent.description_en: The properties of the caption element

BorderColor.description_en:
The color of the text border.

Valid values: 0x000000 to 0xffffff. The default value is an empty string (""), which means this parameter is not used
BorderColor.description_zh:
文字边框色彩。

取值范围为0x000000~0xffffff。默认：""，表示无效

BorderWidthNormalized.description_en:
The normalized width of the text border. The value is calculated based on the font size: BorderWidth/FontSize.

If the calculated value exceeds 16, the value 16 is used. Default value: 0
BorderWidthNormalized.description_zh:
文字边框宽度归一化值。该归一化值是基于文字的size来计算的，即BorderWidth/FontSize。

如果系统归一化反计算出来的值超过16，取16。默认值为0

Color.description_en: The color of the text. Valid values: 0x000000 to 0xffffff

FontName.description_en:
The font. The value must be a preset value. Valid values:

KaiTi: KaiTi

AlibabaPuHuiTi-Regular: Alibaba PuHuiTi Regular

AlibabaPuHuiTi-Bold: Alibaba PuHuiTi Bold

NAlibabaPuHuiTi-Light: Alibaba PuHuiTi Light

NotoSansHans-Regular: Noto Sans CJK Regular

NotoSansHans-Bold: Noto Sans CJK Bold

NotoSansHans-Light: Noto Sans CJK Light

Default value: KaiTi
FontName.description_zh:
字体名字取系统预设值。取值：

KaiTi：楷体。
AlibabaPuHuiTi-Regular：阿里巴巴普惠体-常规。
AlibabaPuHuiTi-Bold：阿里巴巴普惠体-粗体。
NAlibabaPuHuiTi-Light：阿里巴巴普惠体-细体。
NotoSansHans-Regular：思源黑体-常规。 
NotoSansHans-Bold：思源黑体-粗体。 
NotoSansHans-Light：思源黑体-细体。 

默认为KaiTi

LineSpaceNormalized.description_en: The line spacing. This parameter specifies the space between two lines of text. Default value: 0
LineSpaceNormalized.description_zh: 行间距。表示每两行字之间的间隔。默认值为0

LocationId.description_en: If the component type is caption, this parameter specifies the location of the referenced video source (the channel ID)
LocationId.description_zh: 组件类型为caption时，表示引用的视频源Location（通道IChannelId）

PtsOffset.description_en:
The value used to correct the drift between the presentation timestamp (PTS) of the caption and the PTS of the audio.

Valid values: -10000 to +10000. Default value: 0
PtsOffset.description_zh:
纠正当前字幕pts与语音pts偏差值。

取值范围为 -10000~+10000。默认值为0

ShowSourceLan.description_en:
Specifies whether to display the source language. Valid values:

true: The source language is displayed.

false (default): The source language is not displayed
ShowSourceLan.description_zh:
是否显示源语言。取值：

true：显示。
false（默认值）：不显示

SizeNormalized.description_en:
The normalized font size. The font size is set to `[font_size,output_height]`.

If the calculated font size is greater than 1024, the value 1024 is used. The default value is -1, which means this parameter is not used
SizeNormalized.description_zh:
字体归一化大小，字体设置大小为`[font_size,output_height]`。

如果系统根据归一化方式反计算的出来的字体大小大于1024，取1024。默认值为 -1，表示无效

SourceLan.description_en:
The source language of the video source audio. Valid values:

en: English

cn (default): Chinese

es: Spanish

ru: Russian
SourceLan.description_zh:
视频源的原始音频语言。取值：
en：英文。
cn（默认）：中文。
es：西班牙文。
ru：俄文

TargetLan.description_en:
The target language of the video source audio. Valid values:

en: English

cn (default): Chinese

es: Spanish

ru: Russian
TargetLan.description_zh:
视频源的目标音频语言。取值：
en：英文。
cn（默认）：中文。
es：西班牙文。
ru：俄文

WordCountPerLine.description_en: The maximum number of characters to display per line

WordSpaceNormalized.description_en: The character spacing. This parameter specifies the space between two characters. Default value: 0
WordSpaceNormalized.description_zh: 字间距，表示每两个字之间的间隔。默认值为0

WordsCount.description_en:
The number of characters to display. You can adjust this value along with the font size.

Valid values: 10 to 50. Default value: 35
WordsCount.description_zh:
显示字数，可配合字体大小调整。

取值范围为10~50。默认值为35

ComponentLayer.description_en: The size, layout, and other information of the component layer
ComponentLayer.description_zh: 组件Layer的尺寸，布局等信息

HeightNormalized.description_en:
The normalized height of the layer element. The width of the element is scaled proportionally based on this height.

The default value is 0, which means the element is displayed in its original size
HeightNormalized.description_zh:
Layer元素的高度归一化比例值，其中元素的宽度会按照该高度来进行等比缩放。 

默认值为0，表示按照元素的原始尺寸进行显示。

Position.description_en:
The normalized coordinates of the layer element, in the format `[x,y]`. Default value: `[0,0]`.

The values of x and y must be normalized
Position.description_zh:
Layer 元素的位置归一化值`[x,y]`, 默认为`[0,0]`。 

x，y需要进行归一化计算

PositionRefer.description_en:
The reference point for the element's position. Valid values:

topLeft (default): The top-left corner.

topRight: The top-right corner.

bottomLeft: The bottom-left corner.

bottomRight: The bottom-right corner
PositionRefer.description_zh:
元素的位置参考坐标值。取值：

topLeft（默认值）：左上。
topRight：右上。
bottomLeft：左下。
bottomRight：右下

Transparency.description_en:
The transparency of the layer. Valid values: 0 to 255.

A value of 0 indicates that the layer is fully transparent. A value of 255 (default) indicates that the layer is fully opaque
Transparency.description_zh:
该Layer的透明度，取值范围为0~255。

0代表完全透明。255（默认）代表完全不透明

WidthNormalized.description_en:
The normalized width of the layer element. The height of the element is scaled proportionally based on this width. The default value is 0, which means the element is displayed in its original size.

This parameter conflicts with HeightNormalized. If both are set, only HeightNormalized takes effect. If you set only one, the value set later overrides the previous one
WidthNormalized.description_zh:
Layer元素的宽度归一化比例值，其中元素的高度会按照该宽度来进行等比缩放。默认值为0，表示按照元素的原始尺寸进行显示。

该字段和heightNormalized有冲突。一旦同时设置，只有heightNormalized生效。如果只能设置一个，后面设置的值会影响前面的设置

ComponentName.description_en: The component name. The default value is the component ID

ComponentType.description_en:
The component type. Valid values:

text: Text component.

image: Image component.

caption: Translated caption component
ComponentType.description_zh:
组件类型。取值：
text：文字组件。
image：图像组件。 
caption：翻译字幕组件

Effect.description_en:
The display effect of the component. Valid values:

none: No effect.

animateH: Horizontal scroll.

animateV: Vertical scroll
Effect.description_zh:
组件显示的特效。取值： 
          
none：无。
 
animateH：水平滚动。
 
animateV：垂直滚动

ImageLayerContent.description_en: The properties of the image element

MaterialId.description_en: The ID of the media asset

LocationId.description_en:
The position of the component.

You can set only one component for each position. The format must be "RC01" to "RC12"
LocationId.description_zh:
用于指定组件位置。

每个位置至多设置一个组件，格式需符合“RC01…RC12”

Default value: KaiTi

字体名字取系统预设值。取值：

SizeNormalized.description_en:
The normalized font size.

The size is set to font_size/output_height. If the calculated font size is greater than 1024, the value 1024 is used. The default value is -1, which means this parameter is not used
